For durable BT execution without embedding the Rust library, submit a `behavior_tree` task via `POST /v1/tasks/submit`. The coordinator dispatches to a healthy runtime, checkpoints the blackboard every N ticks, and automatically recovers to a new runtime if the executing one goes dark. The `/v1/btree/run` endpoint runs trees without WAL — use it for quick stateless execution only.

The current runtime build does **not** expose a public local `GET /v1/receipts` listing endpoint. If you are running fully local, consume the signed `execution_receipt` data returned in responses and store it in your own workflow if you need local retention.
`POST /v1/mcp` is the agent-facing MCP endpoint. It is backed directly by Igris's
(`POST /v1/mcp`) and, scoped to its tenant, can do four things:

The script prepares local proof artifacts, builds or reuses the Runtime binary, builds Overture, starts a local mock upstream, starts Runtime on `127.0.0.1:8080`, starts Overture on `127.0.0.1:8081`, submits one `/v1/infer` request, and fails if Overture falls back away from Runtime.
- **Request**: the script sends one request through Overture's `/v1/infer` surface.
- `POST /proof/receipts/verify` compares submitted receipt values against the stored record and returns proof-status information
Use `GET /v1/receipts/export` when another system, reviewer, or audit process needs the record outside the immediate execution flow.

The production Igris integration path is **registered actions**: register an action once, then run it by name and inspect the durable run. That path is plain HTTP — `POST /v1/actions/:name/run` works from any language with any HTTP client — so an SDK is a convenience, not a requirement.

The hosted inference surface (`/v1/infer`, `/v1/chat/completions`) is **experimental and disabled by default** — it requires an explicit experimental feature flag on the deployment and is not the product entry point. Registered actions are. If your deployment has the inference surface enabled, the native SDKs expose typed inference calls (`client.infer` in JavaScript/Go/Rust, `chat_completion` in Python), and any OpenAI-style client can point at `https://overture.igrisinertial.com/v1`. Treat that path the way the [API reference labels it](/docs/api-reference): experimental, not part of the stable contract.

Runs in the approval queue do not time out automatically — they remain PAUSED indefinitely until a decision is made. If you have an SLA on approval response time, monitor queue depth via `GET /v1/history/alerts` filtered by unacknowledged alerts.
